title: Blades — ${profileName}
lead: Edit blade definitions for config/blades.ini. No server — changes stay in the browser until you export.
help.neopixel: NeoPixel strips — main blade, second strips, pixel pommels: data_pin, pixels, power FET(s).
help.simple: Simple PWM accents — Free1–3, motors, single LEDs: type = simple + led; pair with accent_* styles in presets.ini.
help.subBlades: Sub-blades — split one physical strip into styled segments (e.g. main body + crystal chamber on one data line).
help.wiringNote: Wiring lives here; colors and effects live in presets.ini (style = per logical blade). Match firmware NUM_BLADES to the logical blade count shown below.
help.examplesSuffix: (also in the repo next to this editor).
hint.footer: Up to ${maxBlades} wiring entries. Logical blades for presets: ${logicalCount} (match NUM_BLADES and style = count — sub-blade ranges each add one logical blade).
